Jules (SI Eng): heads-up — Meridian Cargo's dry-run failed: model server exits during startup. hitting PCIe link resets and intermittent OOM on init.
Ravi (Platform): what's the host and image?
Jules (SI Eng): image: rnw-private-2026-03 (sha: b7a9). Host: Supermicro SYS-430G with A100S 80GB. kernel shows pci 0000:65:00.0: can't recover link, and nvidia-smi shows driver 535.86 CUDA 12.1.
Tasha (Solutions): customer is strict on air-gapped image. they don't want a replacement image unless necessary. They asked for options: short-term hosted fallback, BIOS update, or driver tweak.
Marta (PM): timeline: go-live cutover in 48h. we need a recommendation by EOD.
Ravi (Platform): first step repro in lab with same image and a Supermicro board. try toggling NVLINK aggregation and test with libnvrtc 12 vs 11.5.
Jules (SI Eng): confirmed libnvrtc in image is 11.5.
ticket-bot: [AUTO] created RNW-DEP-5033 (high) assigned to eng-platform, si-field, and solutions.
Ravi (Platform): plan: 1) repro in lab (Ravi + Jules) — 3h, 2) if repro, produce driver 540 + CUDA12.2 image variant and smoke test — 6h, 3) schedule a 90-min staging window with Meridian for swap and rollback test — Tasha to coordinate.
Tasha (Solutions): i'll draft the customer communication explaining hosted fallback latency and costs, and request the staging window.
Jules (SI Eng): i'll capture dmesg and kernel logs during repro; if we see "GPU has fallen off the bus" we'll collect PCIe topology and DTB.
Marta (PM): please keep updates short here. we'll escalate to enterprise lead if we need a firmware BIOS vendor interaction.
Jules (SI Eng): noted — logging details in RNW-DEP-5033 and will ping here for critical updates only. :thumbsup:
